Before you trust a finance video

3 red
flags 🚩

Red flag 1

"Guaranteed
returns"

No real investment can promise that. Returns come with risk.

Red flag 2

Hidden
sponsorship

Paid to promote it? EU guidance says: disclose it openly, not just with a hashtag.

Red flag 3

High risk,
no risk talk

CFDs, forex, futures, volatile crypto: you can lose 100% of what you put in.

Save this.
Send it to a friend.

Investedia · Invest with clarity
Source: ESMA finfluencer factsheet for Belgium (Jan 2026). Education, not financial advice.
